chapters: Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Akâb guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Okôsiias guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak ga'ra' gu Samaria; gio ba' kua' ka'ook bhañ jix duu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' ko'kdai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; gio ba' bamii' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria daipu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios va'k koi gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas ka't.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix duu suulh gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora' bhañ ja'xñi; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon gu Por guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios va'k koi tɨɨda'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't daakat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tai gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' tɨip guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jootom.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tai gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨip vaik guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mii' dhɨr vaik guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kɨkbok vupui bhaan gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tai gu tɨkɨr tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook dharka' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' gu oidha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios va'k koi tɨɨda'.

Jano' ba' jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gook oidha' tas gu Joram gu mar gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' gu Okôsiias cham ga'ra' gu mar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Okôsiias cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tɨkɨr gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Eliseeo gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Bet-el; mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Bet-el gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu Eliseeo guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gook tu jiim ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' naaka'n gu suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p a'lhiok guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' va'k ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨndak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't bhaan tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na pai' dhuuk tu' tu jiim na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' tu' cham.

Jano' ba' ka't jiimchu' a'gi'ñchu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tai bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai jix ai'chdhix gook; gio ba' gu Eliiyas jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Eliseeo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel gu ja'tkam kavaayo cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix ñi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Eliiyas ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim jugii'ñ gu Jordaan.

Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Eliiyas ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam naaka'n gu suudai'; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' jimchu' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo baasɨ'n gui'p; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Eliiyas jix utu'ñ bhaan gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu'x jai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jano' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' baas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' mɨjɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vaik gu tanoolh gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk suulh ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jerikoo; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' kiicham jix bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan tu'; gu' gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Ba' jix aa' gamai' tu jiim gu suudai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu suudai' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ koi'm tu' ko'kdai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt moor guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' tɨɨgɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ñi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' moor gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kavɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oo'm gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Karmelo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Samaria bhaan gu Israeel oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham na ja'p gu taat gu naan; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu Baal gu taat ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Mesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' ali' karneer guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Gu' gu' jix koi gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu Samaria gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu Israeel.
