Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu mar jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Giesi na ba' jix duu; gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhix guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' gu mar gu Jawatan cham tu ñi'ook tu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Giesi; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' oi'ñdha' tu' tu jiim cham tulhiiñdha'; jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' tu' tulhiiñdha' cham tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu naan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup chɨ'ɨɨk; gio ba' gu Giesi ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu' tu' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' tɨbiap gu Eliseeo gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix koi bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' baakɨk jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chin bhaan gu chin gu vupui bhaan gu vupui gu noobh bhaan gu noobh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chuukug guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak baasɨ'n mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' kɨɨv mui'kim jix kupi'ook gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Giesi; gio ba' mɨmɨim dhi' gu Sunamita; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt; jano' ba' baakɨk jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu mar.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu mar jix buus.

Jano' ba' gu Eliseeo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gilgal; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vupui guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix buus maa'n yooxi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na gu' cham bhai'x ka't.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mi' dhɨr na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu chichio'ñ; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios koi'm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jugi.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jugi gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Baal-salisa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu takarui' kai' vaas tiriik jix vɨɨk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' jix maa gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jugi guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan koi'mɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu Naamaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix maa gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu Siria; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu' gakiidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Siria guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat baabuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' gu Israeel tɨɨyax; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'vɨ gu Naamaan.
Ba' jix aa' aapi'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Samaria guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dua'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' baakɨk gu Naamaan gu Jawatan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tɨɨyax gu oidha' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ta'tak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jootsa' tu' tu duukam gu Naamaan na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dua'ñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix maa gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ dua'ñdha' gu Konsiderad jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tu jiim bua' bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Eliseeo gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jajannulhi'ñ bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jajannulhi'ñ gu Benga jano' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham tu'x jai'ch jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Naamaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Eliseeo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo bhañ mattuda' bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kɨɨv mui'kim gu Jordaan gu chuukug tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka' na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu Naamaan ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' chɨtda na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kua' tɨɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam pai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dua'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' gu Abana gu Parpar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Damasko cham tutkɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu suudai' gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio na jix bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka' na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaav guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kɨɨv mui'kim gu Jordaan jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chuukug guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu chuukug guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't na jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx chu'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' kakasnira' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan dhi' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Naamaan; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham maa'n tu duukam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu duukam cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan ba'k vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu novɨ tu' gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon tu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr ta'tak jix jiim na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Giesi jix duu gu Eliseeo gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan dhi' gu Siro gu Naamaan cham dhaagɨk gu novɨ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Giesi gu Naamaan; gio ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Naamaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' jix duu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' xoi'kam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' gu Miren tɨɨtɨs tu' dhi' gu tas gu kavɨk gu Epraim gook biipibop gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Naamaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook cha'tmam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gook cha'tmam jix toja jodai gook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu jiim ka't pai' ɨxchuixim jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu chichio'ñ bhaai'n.

Jano' ba' chɨbiapui jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu Eliseeo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr duukat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Giesi jix aa'; jano' ba' tu duukam cham tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios matgɨm baasɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na pai' dhuuk cham ka't gio gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kakneer gu vaakax tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan.
Jano' ba' dua'ñdha' gu Naamaan tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' jix buus vupui bhaan gakiidha' jix toja na ja'p jabook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gui'p gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨndak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ pai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' maa'n; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'u.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n gu u'u guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu suudai'; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix kavɨk jodai.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' ga'ra' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' tu jiim pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim pai' na gu' gu Siros guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ mii' dhɨr pai' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu jiim tu' gook.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chɨkka guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Eliseeo gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios duukat na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dotaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam kavaayo guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' mia'n kiicham bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kavɨk ka't jix bhuup gu ja'tkam kavaayo guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu tai xikoolh gu Eliseeo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Siros guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Eliseeo gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu jiim dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr naaka'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo; gio ba' cham dhi' gu bhóogɨt tu' dhi' kiicham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gaagim; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Samaria gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui suulhgia' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui tu jiim gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't buupui gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨɨx u'u gat gu Pon vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu suudai' na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' jugi; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhañ suulh gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Siria gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jum daa'ñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu Samaria ua'tulhdhidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mo'o buur ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam giokda' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' bhɨi gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak jodai gu u'vɨ jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' dodhia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios duukat tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' ulhña' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu xibh jugi guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu mar guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu mar.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' jix kai gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak jodai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' mo'o gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Eliseeo daakat gu vaak bɨɨx mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ daraa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu chio'ñ; gu' va'k mattuda' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix aa' daraa; na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui gu ñi'ook dhi' gu mar mua'kam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mo'o gu Mirad na pai' dhuuk daraibu' mattuda' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ki'ñgob tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ba'k; gio ba' cham jupaabkamu'n bhaan tɨroon tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mattuda' tɨmñim; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n; jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kai' vaas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' ka't maakobh gu chichio'ñ tootolhidhat ba'k ki'ñgob gui'p maa'n; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ baakɨi kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhiogi' cham tu'x jai'ch kiicham koi; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio koi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siros; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' duaka'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios koi'm koi.
Jano' ba' jix búup gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' na ba' jix duu yooxi' gu Siros; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tumiiñku dhi' gu Siros cham ka't gu chio'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam yooxi' gu Siros guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan no'ch gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos gu gɨ'kora' gu Egipkios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaak zel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm buur yooxi' na ja'p ka't; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tootolhidhat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tumiiñku dhi' baap vaak zel koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa baap vaak zel gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gui'p maa'n; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios no'ch guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' kapbhai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jix maa jiiñak nuuka'n ki'ñgob kiicham jix duu bham; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' gu Siros guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook buur gio gu ñi'ook yooxi' na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' tu jiim jix maa jiiñak jix duu tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' gu tukaa' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Siros; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tañia' bhiogi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak zel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiicham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ko'iix ba'k kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jano' jixchamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham na gu' gio na ja'p bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr gio na ja'p bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhañ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan yooxi' gu Siros bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhuup jajannulhi'ñ jix duu gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr suulh jix duu tu' maachim gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix buus guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ yooxi' gu Siros; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kai' vaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas ki'ñgob mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam ba'k jix koi jurtu'nka' ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaav.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kai' vaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu xibh dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va; na gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ba'k jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duaka' bham; gio ba' bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' bɨx gu vaak duaka' pai' jix duu; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨgim bhiogi' ɨlhdham gio bhaan gu oidha' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix búup tu' jix duu na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ta'tak bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak jix oidha' gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus na ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Giesi jix duu gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨ'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duaka' jix koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duaka' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Giesi; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu u'vɨ dhi' gu mar gu Eliseeo jix duu duaka'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu Eliseeo ka't gu Damasko gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't ka'ook jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨbiap.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu asael; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr no'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' ko'kdai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu asael gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx xoi'kam gu Damasko oo'm jix ai gu ñi'ook jix buus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix dhaas vupui bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bham; jano' ba' no'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' ko'kdai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ii'mdagaram; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' koi gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ juruuñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu asael; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan jix aa'; na gu' tu' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tai biipibop koo'nda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn a'aalh bhi'spio'kai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu asael; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu duukam gagai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix aa' gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.
Ba' jix aa' ta'tak gu Eliseeo suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ii'mdagaram.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu vupui gu Ben-adad jix koi; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu asael pai'.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam oidha' tas gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joram gu mar gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb na gu' mar u'vɨ gu Akâb ka't gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Edom bɨtaa'n gu novɨ gu Judaa jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Joram guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Seir bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx; gio ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' naaka'n gu Idumeos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mia'n guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Edom guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Libna guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joram guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joram bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Okôsiias gu mar.
Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Okôsiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' oidha' tas gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Ataliia mar u'vɨ gu Omri gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Akâb tu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Akâb.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Ramot gu Galaad bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' gu Siros jix duu gu Joram.

Na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jesreel na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Siros vupui bhaan gu Ramot na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; na gu' jix dhaav gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Jesreel na gu' ka't ka'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo jup tɨɨt maa'n gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨ'ñdhatu' gu novɨ tu' gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josapat gu mar gu Nimsi; gio ba' baakɨk gu vupui guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan mo'o tu'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' na ja'p chɨbiapui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; jano' ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx no'ch jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix búup chɨbiapui gu vaak; gio ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Akâb gu Jawatan na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jesabel.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaak gu Akâb guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Akâb bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Akâb na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia.

Jano' ba' gu Jesabel jugi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ yooxi' gu Jesreel cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kupi'ook ki'ñgob guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Jeuu tu duukam gu Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chɨbiapui tu' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'p gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix dhaas maa'n bɨtaa'n atooxkor guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gui'p; gio ba' gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josapat gu mar gu Nimsi bhaan gu Joram; gio ba' ka't gu Joram guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu Jesreel na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' aagak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jesreel.

Na gu' jano' ba' gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Jesreel na gu' gu Joram ka't ka'ook; gio ba' gio gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Joram.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't bhi'ñbak gu Jesreel jix ñi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr gu Joram jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n kavaayo guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' ka't kavaayo tu jiim; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr mattuda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ kavaayo guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jupaabkamu'n na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi na gu' jupaabkamu'n guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix buus gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios moor guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel.

Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Joram gu Jeuu; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jesabel gu naan mumua'da' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Okôsiias; gio ba' gu Traikioon gu Okôsiias.

Gu' gu' gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'u gat tu' naaka'n gu Joram tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeuu gu Bidkar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨnkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Aañ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Akâb gu taat gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan bham.

Ba' jix aa' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Nabot guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' gu maa'nkar jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jano' bɨnkam gu maa'nkar jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu vaak u'uu pai'; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Jeuu bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Gur ju'ñdharan gu Ibleam; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Megiddo jix koi.
Jano' ba' tu duukam bhɨɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat tukga'n kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim oidha' tas gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Okôsiias bhaan gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mi' dhɨr gu Jeuu gu Jesreel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mo'o guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jeuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Simri guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jano' ba' gu vupui bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chɨkka tu jiim bhaan gook vaik guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ɨ'ɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mi' dhɨr jix jugi jix i'i; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu na ba' tu jiim cham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' suulh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel jugi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jesabel.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jesabel ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu Teniia gu Akâb gu Samaria guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ua'na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jeuu bhañ gu Samaria gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel daraa gu ñi'ook gu Akâb bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat namki' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan namki' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tutkɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam atooxkor gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Gu' gu' chooto'n choo'n gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jeuu; gio ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na gookim tu jiim bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ɨɨbhidham gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan jix duu gu xibh dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' gu Jesreel; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kiicham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ jix dhaas ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mattuda' jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ɨɨbhidham gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gook gɨ' kavɨk ba'k ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.

Ba' jix aa' namkia' gu xibh jix buus kua' tɨɨt bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jir bhai' ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu Jawatan jix koi; jano' ba' gu' chɨkka tu' jix koi bɨx dhi' ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak gu Akâb cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' ba' gu Jeuu bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Akâb gu Jesreel bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix búup suudai' u'va gu Samaria; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bipia'dam.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu'ch gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨbiap tulhiiñdha' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ko'iix; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ko'iix guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ju'ñdharan oidha' suudai' gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oo'm gook gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't tulhiiñdha' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jonadab jix aa'; jano' ba'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu novɨ; jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa baidhak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jeuu tu jiim gu Samaria guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Akâb gu Samaria bɨɨx ka'm jix duu jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ gu Jeuu bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Baal; gu' gu Jeuu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix jai'.

Jano' ba' mɨmɨim bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal bɨx tu duukam bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'n na gu' no'ñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba' gu Baal; mi' dhɨr no'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham ii'mdagaram; jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jeuu bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' cham tu' duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Baal.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeuu; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Baal; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jeuu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs bɨx tu duukam gu Baal cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' baap vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal jix bhuup guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' bɨx tu duukam gu Baal; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Jeuu bɨɨx gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal tu duukam gu Baal; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook cham ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat oi'ñdha' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu duukam gu Baal.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p baap na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jeuu jix dhaas mai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' no'x guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga oi'ñdha' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jeuu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' ba'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm kiicham vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu vaak gu Baal guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' gu Baal guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Baal tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jeuu gu Baal gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jeuu cham jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' maachim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ali' vaakax jix uam jodai mi'p gu Bet-el gu Dan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeuu; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu Akâb jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan atooxkor gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Gu' gu' gu Jeuu cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh kua'da' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu asael bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Jordaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tas bɨx gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Gad gu Rubeen gu Manasees dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon gu Galaad gu Basaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Jeuu bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joakâs gu mar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'kora' gu Jeuu bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Ataliia gu naan gu Okôsiias ñɨi'ñ gu mar ka't jix koi jix búup guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu kai' vaak ja'tkam.

Gu' gu' dhaagɨk gu Josaba mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias gu Joas gu mar gu Okôsiias jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan gu Ataliia guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam Cham cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Ataliia ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv oidha' tas bhañ gu Joiada jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baidhak gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨjɨkgɨm juanda' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak na ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maachim bɨx gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ juanda' gui'x jix nukadham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' dhi' xikoolh gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ua'tulhdhidha' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh no'x ba'k tu jiim dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't jix koi; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na pai' dhuuk ba'k.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu bɨx na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' dhaagɨk maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maachim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat baakɨi juanda' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim juanda' tɨɨtɨs gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ua'tulhdhidha' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh dɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Joiada gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas kuruun chuut tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu noobh gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Ataliia guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' ka't ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chiñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Ataliia guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' gu Traikioon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix maa pai' na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' ba'k kavaayo gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Joiada ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' chɨbiapui vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Mataan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Baal vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bhɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix daa gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham juruuñ jɨɨpi'ñka' dhaibu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Ataliia muukix guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ju'ñdharan gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Joas kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv oidha' tas gu Jeuu kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joas jix gɨ'kora' oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Sibia gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joas gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' bɨx tuumiñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tuumiñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tuumiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx tuumiñ maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn aagak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bakia' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Gu' gu' oidha' tas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Joas cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joas daañxi'ñdha' gu Joiada jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jano' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tuumiñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tuumiñ gu ja'tkam tu' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' daañxi'ñdha' gu Joiada jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix dhaas ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu novɨ na ja'p ba'k vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu jiim ka't jix jai' tuumiñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨ'ya'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'u gu jodai tɨ'ya' na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak na ba' tu jiim.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix toja jodai tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaaso jix uam jodai tu' jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam bɨɨx tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ gu noobh tuumiñ ka't dhagia' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tuumiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tuumiñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Gat jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' jix dhaas gu asael gu vupui na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhɨɨ gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'nkar na jix maa ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Josapat gu Joram gu Okôsiias tattat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' ta'tak gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix búup tu duukam tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Joas gu vaak gu Millo guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Silla.
Na gu' gu Josakâr gu mar gu Simaat gu Josabad gu mar gu Somer tu duukam jix duu jix koi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu mar.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Joas gu mar gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joakâs gu mar gu Jeuu bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios chɨ'ɨɨk uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel do'ñcho gu novɨ gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu novɨ gu Ben-adad gu mar gu asael guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Gu' gu' gu Joakâs guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix kai; na gu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios boosolh gu Israeel moor guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu Siros; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' na ja'p va'k.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr gio guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samaria; jano' ba'.

Na gu' na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Joakâs guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ kavaayo mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p oo' na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joakâs bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joakâs bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joas gu mar.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix bɨx uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix jiim.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joas bɨɨx tattat jix daa gu Jeroboam bhaan atooxkor; gio ba' gu Joas ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samaria bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Eliseeo ka'ook mii' dhɨr ko'kdai' jix koi; gio ba' jix dhaav gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel joi'ndam vupui bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
