Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ bhaan u'u gat; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu novɨ bhaan u'u gat; jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Eliseeo gu noobh bhaan gu noobh gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix kupi'ook jix aa' gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' jix duu jix aa' gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tulhiiñdha' bhaan gu Siria; na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Siros gu Apek bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha'; gio ba' naaka'n vaik mui'kim jix utu'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duu jixchamaam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mui'kim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Siria bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jano' vaik mui'kim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Siria.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eliseeo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' kia'mi'ñ oidha' tas tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Moabitas gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ tukga'n gu Eliseeo; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kuichdha' jix koi o'oo gu Eliseeo guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix búup bhaan tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Joakâs.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu' duu tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Ben-adad gu mar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu Ben-adad gu mar gu asael jɨ'dɨlh ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ gu Joakâs gu taat bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' vaik mui'kim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Joas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oidha' tas gook gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Joaddan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Joas gu taat.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ naaka'n tu duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jurtu'nka' ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' cham yaa' tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam tu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tattat; gu' maa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' dhi' naaka'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu Idumeos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Salinas jix bhɨɨ gu Sela guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhɨɨ'ñdham jup tɨɨt gu Jokteel bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Amasiias bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu mar gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Liibano bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr jix maa mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu mar; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaakax tu jiim gu Liibano guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Edom gu i'ii'ñ tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu Judaa bɨndak.

Gu' gu' gu Amasiias cham jix maa maatɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Bet-semes gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan gu Israeel jiboi'ññor maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu mar gu Joas gu mar gu Okôsiias gu Bet-semes; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak jodai gu Jerusalem dɨr ki'ñgob gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix bɨɨx duu bakia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joas bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samaria bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jeroboam gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix oidha' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Amasiias cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu jiim bhaan gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lakîs; gu' mɨjɨ bhaan gu Lakîs guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' aichdhak bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu Asariias ka't mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Elat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Judaa mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix koox bɨɨx tattat.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Joas bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios cham jix ai'chdhix bɨx uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel dɨr ba'k gu Amat bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Jonaas gu mar gu Amittai jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu Gat-eper.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel; na cham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' koi u'ua'tɨdham gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Joas.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Judaa gu Israeel gu Damasko gu amat cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Jeroboam bɨɨx tattat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Sakâriias gu mar.
Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jeroboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Asariias gu mar gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jekoliia gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu taat gu Amasiias ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx dua'ñdha' ka't gakiidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jotam gu mar gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Asariias guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Asariias bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jotam gu mar.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Asariias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' gu Sakâriias gu mar gu Jeroboam bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tattat; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sallum gu mar gu Jabes naaka'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix gɨ'kora' pai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sakâriias guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jeuu bham; gio ba' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Sallum gu mar gu Jabes kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Ussiia gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Samaria.
Na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Manaem gu mar gu Gadi gu Tirsa suudai' u'va gu Samaria tu' naaka'n gu Sallum gu mar gu Jabes gu Samaria guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix gɨ'kora' pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sallum guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' naaka'n gu Manaem gu Tipsa bɨx mi'p gio guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gu Tirsa; na gu' tu' naaka'n na gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix kupi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix kupi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Asariias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' gu Manaem gu mar gu Gadi bhaan gu Israeel mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Pul gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu oidha'; na gu' jix maa gu Manaem gu Pul mambhɨɨx gɨ' cha'tmam jix toja jodai na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Manaem dhi' tuumiñ bhaan gu Israeel bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' maa'n mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Manaem guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manaem bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Pekaiia gu mar.
Jano' ba' oidha' tas mambhɨɨx gu Asariias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' gu Pekaiia gu mar gu Manaem bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' naaka'n gu Samaria guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam chu'p gu Argob gu Arip bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Galaaditas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix gɨ'kora' pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Pekaiia guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' oidha' tas mambhɨɨx gook gu Asariias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix gɨ'kora' gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Peka gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel suudai' u'va gu Tiglat-pileser gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios jix bhɨɨ gu Aioon gu Abel-bet-maakâ gu Janoa gu Kedes gu Asor gu Galaad gu Galilea bɨx gu oidha' gu Neptalii; gio ba' bhaan gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias tu' naaka'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix gɨ'kora' pai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jotam gu mar gu Ussiia.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Peka bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gook oidha' tas gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jotam gu mar gu Ussiia gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jerusa mar u'vɨ gu Sadok.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu taat gu Ussiia.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr pai'x ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jotam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ oi'ñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Samaria guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Bet-el guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ja'tkam kiicham pai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Babiloonia jix duu gu Sukkot-benot gu Kuta gu Nergal gu amat gu Asima.
Jano' ba' gu ebeos jix duu gu Nibas gu Tartak; gio ba' gu Separbaim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu tai gu Adra-melek gu Anamelek gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chɨbɨɨp pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam na ja'p maa'n; na tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ñi'ook kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' xoi'kam bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Jakob jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx tas tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' va'k jix duu bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp bɨɨma'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn duiñxim; gio ba' gio gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan jix duu tattat xoi'kam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' vaik oidha' tas gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Esekîas gu mar gu Akâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Abi mar u'vɨ gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dabii gu taat.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' bapaalh gu ko'oi jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Moisees na gu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jup tɨɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Neustaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix dhaas nɨɨra; gio ba' mi' dhɨr tu' va'k cham ka't na ja'p bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios cham jix ai'chdhix guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x busaak jix duu; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gɨ' vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm kiicham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' maakobh oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't oidha' tas kɨɨv gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salmanasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bhaan gu Samaria guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' dhi' xijumai oidha' tas gu Esekîas ka't oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Oseas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Samaria guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan gu Israeel gu Asiria jix dhaas gu ala gu abor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Medos.

Na gu' na gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios va'k guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Lakîs; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx tu jiim; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa vaik cha'tmam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Esekîas bɨx jix toja jodai ka't bakia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Esekîas kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas dɨr gu Lakîs bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Tartaan gu Rabsaris gu Rabsakes bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr dhaibu tu jiim tɨɨtɨs tu jiim ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook jiix gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' jix buus gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Sebna guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Joa gu mar gu Asap guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' ja'xñi jano' gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chotdonɨt dhi' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ no'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Ejipto tu' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' tu jiim gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Esekîas tu' tu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' vupui bhaan dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jerusalem.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix ali' tu duukam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨbiap tu' jano' cham gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu jiim dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias gu Sebna gu Joa gu Rabsakes; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' no'ch guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maatɨt gu ja'tkam bhaan vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan tu' gu Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ñi'ook cham va'k gu chichio'ñ bhaan vaak jodai na ba' jugi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam i'i gu suudai' tɨɨt bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Ba' jix aa' tu jiim gu Rabsakes tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Esekîas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios dhi' kiicham cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Esekîas na gu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam iigɨx maa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' oidha' suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' na ja'p gu oidha' kai'ñ suudai' u'va pai' gu takarui' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨ'ñdhatu' suudai' na jix bhai'; gio ba' duaka' cham koi; na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Esekîas na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' gu Akaso oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu amat gu Arpad duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ suulhgia' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Samaria gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Jawatan Dios oidha' gɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' gɨ' gu novɨ na ba' namkidhat gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Sebna guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Joa gu mar gu Asap guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Esekîas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix kai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan dhaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Eliakim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Sebna guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios daraa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos.

Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios gu Jawatan tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim soi'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bakia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas.

Jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham jum i'obh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook naak bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Rabsakes gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Libna; na gu' ka't naak ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Lakîs.

Jano' ba' jix kai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Tiraka gu gɨ'kora' gu Etiopiia; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Esekîas bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham tu' iatgi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' naak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tattat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maachim gu Gosaan jix duu gu Resep gu ma'nkam gu Edeen mi'p gu Talasar.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu gɨ'kora' gu Arpad gu gɨ'kora' kiicham gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Esekîas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't jiñkai'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' jix dhaas gu tai gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam gu noobh gu chichio'ñ gu u'u gu jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Esekîas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria naak.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; mi' dhɨr tu' joi'mdak mo'o guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨkka guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan chɨkka tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; jano' ba' ba'k gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ gu oidha' gu kavɨk gu Karmel.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu vaas tɨɨt bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk naak jix jai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu noobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu gu vaas yooxi' na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaas guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam va'k guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam baakɨi i'iich bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' tu jiim maatɨt tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chin guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' tu' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nɨi'ñchudat gu Esekîas; gio ba' dhi' oidha' tas jugi guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook oidha' tas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr vaik pai' tas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jugi gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tatk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'bhɨ jiix.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk gu Sioon; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi'.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' kiicham tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr tu' ɨlhdham vupui bhaan kutun kavɨk tu' ka't baas bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' kiicham na ba' dodhia' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tukaa' jix buus nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' naaka'n yooxi' gu Asirios chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' na ja'p jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria ta'tak ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Niinibe pai' juruuñ.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Nisrok gu Jawatan Dios gu Adramelek gu Saresar gu ma'nkam jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu oidha' gu Ararat; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Esar-adoon gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Esekîas ka'ook koi'm suudai' u'va gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak na gu' koi cham ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chɨ'ñchoka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' tu'r tu' bɨx bhai' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'x tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Esekîas bɨɨx suanda'.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Isaiiyas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ naadat ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu Esekîas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' naak soi'm buupui suakɨt; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix dhaas bhaan tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' gu Esekîas ka't tu ñi'ook gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaik gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ɨkgiga'n mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix aa'; gio ba' buusnia' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ɨkgiga'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu' ɨkgiga'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Isaiiyas tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ɨkgiga'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Akâs mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Na gu' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Berodak-baladaan gu mar gu Baladaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Esekîas na gu' ka't naak gu Esekîas ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix kai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu vaak tu'x a'bhar jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Esekîas cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak na ja'p bɨx aapi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gui'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ duukat tɨɨtɨs tu' gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx ka't gu vaak; jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu Esekîas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh bɨx gu vaak bɨx tattat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't baabuk gu Babiloonia cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Esekîas bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' kiicham cham ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Esekîas bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Manasees gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem mambhɨɨx jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu epsiba.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Esekîas gu taat ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix búup jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mii' dhɨr tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak ka't gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas dhi' gu vaak gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨɨt gu Israeel ka't joi'mdak gu oidha' tu' tattat bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xoi'kam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu duukam gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix.

Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Manasees guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham.

Na gu' na gu' gu Manasees gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' bɨx jix duu gu Amorreos jix bɨɨx duu va'k gio tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Judaa duiñxim.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim cham bhai' bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maatɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Samaria guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Akâb; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem na ja'p na jix bhai' kutun kavɨk mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar kɨɨsa' gu noobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' ka't na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dɨr gu tanoolh tattat moor gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' mai' dhi' ja'aa gu Manasees guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Judaa na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x uañi'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manasees bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ u'uu pai' gu vaak u'uu pai' gu Ussa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amoon gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Amoon na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Mesalemet mar u'vɨ gu arus gu Jotba.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Manasees gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu taat jix jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu taat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Amoon tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Amoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tukga'n u'uu pai' gu Ussa jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Josiiyas kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Idida mar u'vɨ gu Adaiia gu Boskat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham tu jiim kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas ka't bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sapaan gu mar gu Asaliia gu mar gu Mesullam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ilkiias guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tuumiñ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh xoi'kam tu duukam namki' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' xoi'kam tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'u gu jodai tɨ'ya' na ba' tu jiim gu vaak.
Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tuumiñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ilkiias gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gaagam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ilkiias jix maa u'uan gu Sapaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Ba' jix aa' bai'ñpu' gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tuumiñ gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhagia' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam tu duukam namki' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jix maa u'uan; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Sapaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu Judaa jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ bɨx chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Gedaliias tɨɨtɨs gu Mispa maachim gu Ismael gu mar gu Nataniias gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea gu Saraiia gu mar gu Tanumet gu Netopatita gu Jaasaniias gu mar gu Maakâti bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Gedaliias jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu duukam gu Kaldeos; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv suudai' u'va gu Ismael gu mar gu Nataniias gu mar gu Elisama guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ tu' jix duu gu Gedaliias jix koi; gio ba' gio gu Judiios gu Kaldeos mi'p bɨɨx gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix bɨɨx duu gu Ejipto guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm choo'n gu Kaldeos.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Joakîn gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Ebil-merodak gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia maa'n oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix búup mo'o gu Joakîn gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak kuupa'.
Ba' jix aa' xoi'kam jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx mi'p gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix jugi bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jugi baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tas bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
